method: Sequential production builds, CPU x1/x6; 3 fixed-phase hero samples, remaining scenarios sampled once. CDP tracing and rAF add instrumentation overhead. CPU time is not a real-device FPS guarantee.

results: mobile menu: keyboard, Escape, outside click
catalog drawer after deep scroll: viewport bounds, focus trap, filters, Escape
gallery: thumbnails, dialog, keyboard arrows/Home/End, Escape and focus return
Telegram: seller, Unicode product draft, canonical URL, browser fallback and new tab
product copy: complete inquiry, clipboard and visible success
Viber: encoded native URI, help, keyboard focus, phone copy, Escape and close
mobile buy bar: appears after inquiry, returns to contact and yields to footer
SLA form: editable draft, Unicode, copy and native validation
denied clipboard: product, Viber phone and SLA select complete manual text
404 portrait: entrance, breathing, ears, blink, parallax, hover and offscreen pause; home reveal
messenger hover, press, keyboard focus and pill shape
animation performance: pause/resume, hidden document, batched pointer and bounded filter wave
reduced motion: portrait, ambient effects and messenger hover are still
touch screen: 44px targets, no sticky messenger hover, Viber sheet within viewport
blocked web fonts: fallback typography remains readable and within 320px
failed product image: local placeholder and recovery on another thumbnail
no JavaScript: all products, native mobile menu, contacts, gallery links and SLA fallback
